question: Who was the first person to fly into space?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Yuri Gagarin**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Yuri Gagarin**, a **Soviet astronaut**, became the **first person to fly into space** on **April 12, 1961**.
 
• **Orbited Earth **aboard **Vostok 1** for about **108 minutes**.
 
• His flight marked a **milestone in space exploration**.
 
• Established the **Soviet Union's lead in the space race**.
 
• I**nspired global advancements** in **space technology**.
 
• Symbolizes** humanity's capability for space exploration**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Yelena Serova:**

 
 
• **Yelena Serova** is a **Russian cosmonaut** who flew to the **International Space Station (ISS)** in** 2014**.
 
• She became the **fourth Russian woman **in **space** and the **first Russian woman **to visit the **ISS since 1997**.
 
 
 
• **Valentina Tereshkova****:**
 
 
• **First woman to fly into space**.
 
• Launched aboard **Vostok 6** on **June 16, 1963**.
 
• Completed **48 orbits around the Earth **during her **three-day mission**.
 
• Became a **symbol of women's achievements in space exploration**.
 
 
 
• **Neil Armstrong:**
 
 
• **Neil Armstrong** was an **American astronaut **and the** first person **to **walk on the moon** on **July 20, 1969**, during **NASA's Apollo 11 mission**.
 
• His iconic words, **"That's one small step for a man, one giant leap for mankind," **were **broadcast worldwide**.
